Danger Warning Tags guide

What Is a Danger Warning Tag?

Golden ruleA tag provides information but does not create a physical barrier; wherever a padlock can be fitted, always use the tag together with a padlock.

A danger warning tag is an information tag hung on the locked point and used in the "tagout" step, i.e. the tagging step, of the LOTO process. While the lock physically prevents energy from being restored, the tag clearly shows the reason for this barrier and who is responsible for it. This significantly reduces the risk of misunderstandings and accidental energization between different teams working on the same equipment.

The writable areas of the tag usually record the name of the person who applied the lock, their department, the date of the operation and the reason for lockout. This way, anyone who comes to the equipment immediately understands why the machine must not be started and who to ask for information. Tags made of durable material can be used indoors and outdoors and resist water, oil and chemicals.

Sofilx LOTO offers hanging tags with Turkish text such as "Tamir Var Şalteri Açmayınız" (Under Repair – Do Not Switch On) and "Dikkat Bakım Var Çalıştırma" (Caution Maintenance in Progress – Do Not Operate), lockout information tags and Scafftag tags for scaffold safety.

Buying guide

How to Choose the Right Danger Tag?

Check these criteria before ordering. If you are unsure, send a photo and we will choose together.

Ask an expert
  • Warning text: The message should be short, clear and in Turkish, and understood at a glance by every worker on site.
  • Information fields: There should be enough writing space for the name of the person locking out, their department and the date.
  • Material durability: Choose a tag that resists moisture, oil and UV and does not tear easily.
  • Hanging method: The tag must attach firmly to the padlock or device and must not fall off by itself.
  • Visibility: Choose eye-catching colors and a typeface that can be read from a distance.
  • Corporate need: If you need organization-specific text or identification details, consider the customized tag option.
Applications

Where Are Danger Warning Tags Used?

Electrical panels

Hung next to circuit breaker lockouts, it signals that power must not be applied during maintenance.

Valves and pressurized lines

Used together with valve lockouts, it warns that flow must not be opened.

Machines and production lines

Prevents the machine from being started during maintenance, cleaning and die changes.

Scaffolds

Shows the usage status and inspection information of the scaffold with Scafftag tags.

Frequently asked questions

About Danger Warning Tags

If you could not find the answer you are looking for, message us on WhatsApp and we will determine the right model together.

Ask on WhatsApp
Does a warning tag replace a lock?
No. A tag only provides information; wherever a lock can be fitted, lock and tag must be used together.
What are the prices of danger warning tags?
The price varies by model, material and order quantity. For a current quote and stock information, you can message the product code and quantity to our WhatsApp line or call us by phone.
What information should be written on the tag?
The name of the person applying the lock, their department, the date and the reason for lockout should be written; contact details can also be added if needed.
Are tags with Turkish text available?
Yes, our warning tags carry Turkish text. You can also contact us for custom text printing for your organization.
Can the tags be reused?
Some tags can be reused when the writing areas are filled in with an erasable pen. Worn or unreadable tags must be replaced with new ones.
What is a Scafftag for?
A Scafftag is a status tag that shows whether the scaffold is fit for use; it carries the name of the inspector and the date.
Can the tags be used outdoors?
Yes. The tags are durable enough for indoor and outdoor use and resist water, oil and chemicals.

Danger Warning Tag Prices and Models

In LOTO procedures, another step as important as lockout is tagout. Danger tags prevent accidental energization by clearly showing why the locked-out switch, valve or machine was taken out of service and who is responsible.

Our range includes maintenance and repair warnings, circuit breaker and authorization tags, writable lockout information tags, testing and commissioning tags and Scafftag scaffold tags. All models are hanging type and are easy to use with a lock; we also support requests for company-specific text.

Warning tag prices vary by model and order quantity. To get a current price quote and stock information, you can send the product code to our WhatsApp line or call us by phone.
